scene: a small grey plastic desk fan standing on an art room desk, dust furred into the grille and a torn strip of red sugar paper tied to one bar of it, a stacked pile of cartridge paper weighted with a lump of dry clay beside it, a chipped enamel water jug at the back, hard flat fluorescent light from above and a long window of white sky behind

a paper ferry timetable pinned to a weathered green noticeboard at the top of river steps, the sheet curled at both bottom corners and rippled from damp, four brass drawing pins, sailing times in a plain grid with the last crossing underlined by hand in biro, a strip of older torn paper still stapled beside it, low gold evening light raking across the board

a wide shallow bowl of pale green cold soup on a steel kitchen bench, three cubes of ice still whole on the surface and a thin ring of oil around them, the bowl beaded with condensation and a wet ring under it, a spoon laid across the rim and a halved cucumber on a board behind, one bare bulb and an open window full of blue evening

a canal at low water in a heatwave seen from the towpath, the water dropped to show a bank of cracked grey mud and the rusted frame of a shopping trolley half out of it, bright weed along the far edge, a black mooring ring and a scorched line of dead grass on the path, hard white midday light with no cloud at all

an official exam result letter lying open on a kitchen table, the creases from three folds still standing up, a printed reference number and a single line of result across the middle, the slit envelope underneath it and a mug of cold tea with a skin on it at the corner, a folded roster sheet pushed to the edge, dull light from a window on the left

a cleared kitchen table with a squared stack of printed school reports pushed to one side, the top sheet ruled into boxes and ticked in blue, a closed laptop with a cold mug standing on it, a cheap blue biro lying across the pile and an empty pen tray beside it, late morning light and the shadow of a window frame across the paper

a grey suit on a wire hanger hooked over the top of a door frame, the dry cleaner's clear plastic pushed up to the shoulders and a small paper ticket safety pinned to the lapel, the trousers folded over the bar with a fresh crease, a pair of polished dark shoes together on the floor below, warm bedroom lamp light from one side

a row of white plastic chairs set out on cut grass at the open edge of a marquee, one chair's front legs sunk into the turf and tilted, a printed order of service face down on a seat weighted by a small stone, guy ropes and a wooden peg in the foreground, striped canvas and a bright overcast sky behind

a slice of dark fruit cake with white icing sitting in a folded paper napkin on a coach seat, the napkin printed with two initials and a date, crumbs on the moquette beside it and a folded bus timetable, the window black with a smear of reflected interior light, dim yellow overhead reading lamp
